label: Reliability of a vendored dataset record, v0.1.0
description: Scores how far a dataset record under test-data/organisms/ is an authentic, complete, independently produced record of what it describes, following the dataset convention of the Project Delphi ontology (ONTOLOGY.md, 'Dataset convention'). The hypothesis assessed is 'dataset X is an authentic, complete record of what it describes'. Each dimension is a graded judgement in [0,1] (delphi:hasScore), never a probability. Fitness of a dataset for a particular claim is NOT scored here; it belongs to the claim's assessment. The assessor must not be the agent that vendored the record.

dimensions.label: Source authority
dimensions.question: Is the source peer-reviewed or a curated, governed repository with a data paper, versioning and a stable identifier, or an unreviewed upload?

anchors.0.0: anonymous or unreviewed upload, no versioning, no data paper, no governance
anchors.0.5: institutional or community database without a data paper or without versioning; or a data paper but no persistent identifier
anchors.1.0: peer-reviewed data paper or a governed international infrastructure (e.g. GBIF, NCBI, WoRMS, PBDB) with a DOI or stable identifier, documented curation and versioning

dimensions.label: Integrity
dimensions.question: Does the identifier still resolve, and does every distribution's recorded checksum or recorded count match what the repository serves now? For live API counts, is the re-queried value within the tolerance stated below?

anchors.0.0: identifier does not resolve, or a checksum or count was recorded that cannot be reproduced and disagrees materially
anchors.0.5: identifier resolves but a checksum could not be re-verified (download blocked, archive assembled on demand), or a live count drifted beyond tolerance for an explainable reason (new records indexed)
anchors.1.0: identifier resolves and every checksum matches exactly, or every live count re-queried matches within tolerance (relative difference <= 0.5% or absolute <= 5)

dimensions.label: Completeness
dimensions.question: Does the record describe what it claims to describe: are the counts, version, license, creators, citation and distributions present and consistent with what the source publishes (e.g. row counts vs. the data paper, taxon list vs. rows actually matched)?

anchors.0.0: counts or key metadata missing or contradicted by the source
anchors.0.5: metadata present but partly unstated (license null, version implied by date only) or counts not cross-checkable
anchors.1.0: all convention fields present, counts match the source's own statement of its size, taxa listed are actually present in the data

dimensions.label: Independence
dimensions.question: Is the data independent of this project's own outputs and of the claims it will be used to test (not model output, not derived from the claim text, not a re-aggregation of another record in this repository)?

anchors.0.0: derived from this project's models, claims or other vendored records
anchors.0.5: aggregated from third-party sources whose independence from each other is unclear (e.g. compilation databases that ingest one another)
anchors.1.0: primary measurements or curated primary records produced with no relation to this project

dimensions.label: Authenticity
dimensions.question: Is it real measured or observed data rather than synthetic, template or placeholder content, and is the record free of signs of fabrication (invented DOIs, non-existent accessions, round numbers without provenance)?

anchors.0.0: synthetic, template or placeholder content, or a DOI/accession/URL that does not exist
anchors.0.5: real source but some record fields look templated or could not be traced to the source (e.g. citation text not found at the DOI)
anchors.1.0: every identifier, DOI, accession and count traces to the real source; data are measured or observed records

verdicts.rule: authenticity < 0.5 or identifier does not exist

overall: weighted mean of the five dimension scores
